title: Eden Network — Private Key Leakage
summary_ko: 2022년 10월 29일 Eden Network에서 개인키 유출·정보 유출이 발생했다.
summary_en: The ownership of the MEV infrastructure Eden Network deployer address was hacked and took control of the EDEN token contract. The attacker claims that a new token contract will be deployed, and Eden Network can redeem ownership after purchasing 200 ETH of NEDEN.
